title: Remove an unused customization hook
why: An unused callback hook adds branching and API surface for variation that has no current caller.
suggestion: Remove the hook and its fallback path until a concrete caller needs customization.
limitations: Reports optional callback-like parameters on private C# methods and underscore-prefixed Dart, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python functions with at least three visible call sites and a project-unique name.
Requires the function body to invoke the hook and complete evidence that no visible caller supplies it.
Reflective calls, method tear-offs, overload ownership, forwarded callback parameters, and framework-discovered private hooks are not resolved.
